parameters.content:
## Kling 4.0 video queue in Google Sheets across your Kling accounts

For studios, agencies and creators who make Kling videos in volume on several Kling AI subscriptions and want one queue that keeps all of them busy.

It runs through the [useapi.net Kling API](https://useapi.net/docs/api-kling-v1?utm_source=n8n&utm_medium=referral&utm_campaign=kling-sheet-batch), a third-party API, not affiliated with Kuaishou Technology or Kling AI, on the Kling accounts you connect there.

**How it works**
1. One sheet row is one video: a prompt, an optional start and end image, and the model, quality, duration and aspect ratio. The form adds many prompts at once.
2. Every 5 minutes a tick reads your accounts' free job slots and starts new rows. A row without `email` goes to any account with a free slot ([how](https://useapi.net/docs/api-kling-v1?utm_source=n8n&utm_medium=referral&utm_campaign=kling-sheet-batch#run-several-kling-accounts)). A row with `email` runs on that account.
3. The task id and the account go into the row in the same tick, so a restart reads the task instead of paying twice.
4. A finished row gets the video link (the clean master on paid Kling AI subscriptions), the account's credits left and, if you turn it on, a Google Drive copy.

A busy `429` waits for the next tick. A refused or invalid row, or a failed login (`596`), gets `error` and a note. A start that may have used credits (other `5xx`, no answer) is never resent: `check job`.

**Set up**
1. Get a [useapi.net API token](https://useapi.net/docs/start-here/setup-useapi?utm_source=n8n&utm_medium=referral&utm_campaign=kling-sheet-batch) and connect your Kling accounts with [Setup Kling](https://useapi.net/docs/start-here/setup-kling?utm_source=n8n&utm_medium=referral&utm_campaign=kling-sheet-batch).
2. Create a **Header Auth** credential: Name `Authorization`, Value `Bearer <your token>`. Select it on the useapi.net HTTP Request nodes.
3. Copy the sheet columns from [GitHub](https://github.com/useapi/kling-api/tree/main/n8n), connect Google Sheets, and set `sheetId` in **Settings**.
4. Create a **Basic Auth** credential and select it on **Add to the Kling queue**, so only you can add jobs.
5. Publish (activate) the workflow.

You need a useapi.net subscription ($15/month for 3 accounts on each service, $10 for each extra 3) and Kling accounts. Videos need a paid Kling AI subscription (Standard or higher).

Defaults, per-tick limits and Drive are in **Settings**.

### 1. Add prompts from a form
One prompt per line, `prompt | start image | end image` for image-to-video. Each line becomes a `new` row. Basic Auth keeps the form yours.

### 2. Every 5 minutes
Free reads: your accounts, their free job slots (`maxJobs` per account) and the running tasks. **Plan the tick** checks each `new` row (model, duration, mode, links) and starts at most `maxStartsPerTick`, never more than the free slots.

### 3. Start the jobs
No `email` in the row: the API picks a healthy account with a free slot. The task id and account are written at once. Paid calls are never retried by n8n: only `429` waits for the next tick.

### 4. Finished videos
**Read task** polls each `rendering` row on its account. **Clean link** asks for the non-watermarked master (paid Kling AI subscriptions) and **Read balance** gives the real credits left. Optional Drive copy, then one write per row.
